name: il-school-mcp
description: Local read-only assistant for Israeli school portals (Mashov & Webtop)

tools.name: school_list_students
tools.description: List auto-discovered children, classes, and portals

tools.name: school_get_schedule
tools.description: Get daily or weekly lesson timetables

tools.name: school_get_homework
tools.description: Get homework assignments and due dates

tools.name: school_get_behavior
tools.description: Get positive, negative, and attendance behavior logs

tools.name: school_get_exams
tools.description: Get upcoming exams and linked study materials

tools.name: school_get_messages
tools.description: Get school inbox messages and PDF/DOCX attachment text

tools.name: school_open_setup
tools.description: Open local 127.0.0.1 browser setup page for adding or editing accounts

mashov_username.title: Mashov Username / ID (optional)
mashov_username.description: Your Mashov parent or student username/ID. Leave blank if you only use Webtop or prefer browser setup.

mashov_password.title: Mashov Password (optional)
mashov_password.description: Your Mashov account password (stored securely in your OS keychain).

mashov_semel.title: Mashov School Code / סמל מוסד (optional)
mashov_semel.description: Your school's 6-digit Ministry of Education code (semel).

webtop_username.title: Webtop Username (optional)
webtop_username.description: Your Webtop (SmartSchool) username. Leave blank if you only use Mashov.

webtop_password.title: Webtop Password (optional)
webtop_password.description: Your Webtop account password (stored securely in your OS keychain).
